lines.en: label toukadorm25p3:
scene clearnightsky
And so another night ends with me only getting {i}slightly{/i} closer to her — but that’s par for the course when her entire life is built around a world that I have no part in.
lines.zh: 于是，又一夜过去，我只向她靠近了{i}一点点{/i}——可她的整个人生都围着一个我进不去的世界转，这也算意料之中。

lines.en: I stare back at her mansion from the backseat of a ride that I am forced to take and remember just how far apart we are in almost every single way.
lines.zh: 我被迫坐进一辆车的后座，回头望着她那栋宅邸，想起我们在几乎每一个方面隔得有多远。

lines.en: And how even in those few moments of feigned intimacy, where our bodies move closer together than they should ever be...that I am an outsider.
lines.zh: 还有，即便在那几个「假装亲密」的瞬间、我们的身体贴近到不该有的程度……我仍是个局外人。

lines.en: I have been one from the start- and there is no way someone like me, who can’t stop plucking his feathers, could ever take a fledgling bird like her under my wing.
lines.zh: 我从一开始就是局外人——像我这种不停拔自己羽毛的家伙，根本不可能把她这样的雏鸟收进羽翼之下。

lines.en: For even if I could fly, there is nothing I could show her that she can’t already see from the cage she was brought up in.
lines.zh: 因为就算我会飞，也没什么能给她看的——她从自己长大的那只笼子里，早就全看见了。

lines.en: After all, it’s miles higher than any of {i}us{/i} will ever reach.
lines.zh: 毕竟，那笼子比{i}我们{/i}任何人都高出了好几英里。

lines.en: You can look up as much you want — but I will hearken back to another recent metaphor involving a hole and reiterate the fact that ascension is far more difficult than its antonym.
lines.zh: 你想仰望多久都行——但我要借最近另一个关于「洞」的比喻重申：向上爬，远比它的反义词难。

lines.en: She’s the one who will need to come down to us.
lines.zh: 她才是需要「下来」到我们这边的那一个。

lines.en: But she needs to {i}want{/i} it.
lines.zh: 可她得{i}「愿意」{/i}下来。

lines.en: And I’m not quite sure if she ever will.
lines.zh: 而我不太确定她到底会不会。

lines.en: : Arakawa-sama, if you’d be so kind as to inform me of your destination, I would be very grateful. The mistress did not tell me where you were headed tonight.
lines.zh: : Arakawa 大人，若您肯告知目的地，我将感激不尽。夫人没告诉我您今晚要去哪儿。

lines.en: : I don’t really care, to be honest. You can drop me off wherever.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我无所谓。你随便在哪儿放我下来都行。

lines.en: : I can’t-
lines.zh: : 我不能——

lines.en: : It’s fine, really. I’m not a big fan of cars in the first place.
lines.zh: : 没事，真的。我反正本来就不喜欢坐车。

lines.en: : I apologize for the inconvenience.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉给您带来不便。

lines.en: : You may exit the vehicle at your leisure.
lines.zh: : 您可以随时下车。

lines.en: The car screeches to a halt in the middle of nowhere and I remove myself from its metal stomach, half-digested from the acid that’s been dripping from my mind as it runs wild once more.
lines.zh: 车在荒郊野外猛地刹住。我从它那钢铁的肚子里钻出来，被脑海里一路狂奔淌下的酸液浸得半消化。

lines.en: Just, this time, the world alone remains in view.
lines.zh: 只是这一次，眼前只有「世界」本身。

lines.en: There is no blackout nor subsequent confusion from an abrupt change in locale.
lines.zh: 没有昏厥，也没有因地点骤变而来的迷茫。

lines.en: I can feel my limbs and move my body. I can hear the sounds of the gravel beneath my feet as I walk off in a direction I only half-expect to be the right one.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到四肢、能活动身体。我能听见脚下碎石的声响，朝一个我只半信半疑是正确方向的方向走去。

lines.en: And all the while, I wish that I was still in her lap.
lines.zh: 而自始至终，我都希望自己还在她的膝上。

lines.en: I wish we could have looked at each other for more than a handful of seconds.
lines.zh: 我多希望我们能对视得比那短短几秒更久。

lines.en: But it’s better that we didn’t.
lines.zh: 但没那么做更好。

lines.en: scene black
And it’s better that she’s now with someone who understands her instead of someone who simply {i}wants{/i} to.
lines.zh: 而且，她现在跟一个「懂她」的人在一起，而不是一个{i}「只是想去懂她」{/i}的人——这样更好。

lines.en: For a moment, I envision these empty streets as the halls of a lavish manor.
lines.zh: 有一瞬，我把这些空荡的街道想象成一座华丽大宅的厅堂。

lines.en: The streetlights are suits of armor. The stars, a chandelier.
lines.zh: 路灯是一副副铠甲。星星是一盏吊灯。

lines.en: And the moon is the face of someone I wish to see — tragically gazing down from a perspective far more interesting than my own.
lines.zh: 而月亮是某个我想见的人的脸——从一个比我有趣得多的视角，凄然俯视。

lines.en: I’m sure it all looks small to her.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，在她眼里这一切都很渺小。

lines.en: scene toukabath1
And I’m sure that’s just the way she likes it.
lines.zh: 而且我敢肯定，她恰好就喜欢这样。

lines.en: : Hah...I needed this...
lines.zh: : 哈……我需要这个……

lines.en: : Did you have a long day, dear?
lines.zh: : 今天过得很难吗，亲爱的？

lines.en: : “Long” doesn’t even begin to describe it. Every second with that man feels like an hour. And the sudden appearance of Tsukasa did not help very much either.
lines.zh: : 「难」都不足以形容。跟那个男人待的每一秒都像一小时。而且 Tsukasa 又突然冒出来，更是雪上加霜。

lines.en: scene toukabath2
: I’m glad we wound up here instead of the pool. I likely would have drowned from exhaustion if I were to get in there right now.
lines.zh: : 幸好我们最后来了这儿而不是泳池。我要是现在下水，多半会累得淹死。

lines.en: : I might not be a perfect mother, but even I wouldn’t let my eldest daughter drown right before my very eyes.
lines.zh: : 我或许不是个完美的母亲，但就算是我，也不会眼睁睁看着大女儿在眼前淹死。

lines.en: scene toukabath3
: But you would your youngest?
lines.zh: : 可你会看着小女儿淹死？

lines.en: : Oh, stop. You know that’s not what I meant.
lines.zh: : 哦，别这样。你知道我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Of course I do.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道。

lines.en: scene toukabath4
: But if you just {i}happened{/i} to look away for a moment or two, I can’t say I’d blame you.
lines.zh: : 不过，要是你{i}恰好{/i}扭头看别处一两秒，我也不能怪你。

lines.en: : Be nice. Tsukasa may be a handful, but she’s dealing with a lot right now.
lines.zh: : 别这样。Tsukasa 虽然难带，但她现在正扛着很多事。

lines.en: scene toukabath5
: Is she? How so?
lines.zh: : 是吗？怎么回事？

lines.en: : It’s no fault of her own. It’s because of me.
lines.zh: : 不是她自己的错。是因为我。

lines.en: : That can’t be true. You haven’t done anything at all.
lines.zh: : 不可能。你什么都没做啊。

lines.en: : I believe that’s...exactly the issue. Tsukasa’s been feeling...left out, I suppose. She isn’t as inherently accepting of my absence as you were at her age.
lines.zh: : 我想，问题……恰恰在这儿。Tsukasa 一直觉得……被冷落了。她不像你在她那个年纪时那样，天生就能接受我的缺席。

lines.en: : Did she...tell you this? That seems rather mature for her.
lines.zh: : 她……亲口跟你说的？这对她来说也太成熟了。

lines.en: scene toukabath6
: Yes and no. There were some...words she shouted at me in the middle of a meeting. But it was Sensei who pointed out the meaning behind all of them as I struggled to wrap my head around it.
lines.zh: : 是也不是。她在一次会议上……冲我喊了些话。不过，是 Sensei 点破了那些话背后的含义——我自己半天想不明白。

lines.en: : Sensei? You mean...{i}my{/i} Sensei? He did that?
lines.zh: : Sensei？你是说……{i}我的{/i} Sensei？他做的？

lines.en: : Oh? You’re calling him {i}yours{/i} now? Perhaps I {i}was{/i} interrupting before, then.
lines.zh: : 哦？你现在管他叫{i}「你的」{/i}了？看来我先前{i}是{/i}打扰到你们了。

lines.en: scene toukabath7
: D...Don’t be ridiculous! It’s excruciatingly obvious that’s not what I meant. I just didn’t think he paid much attention to her at all.
lines.zh: : 别……别胡说！很明显我不是那个意思。我只是没想到他对她会那么上心。

lines.en: : To think he’d notice something neither of us did despite his limited time with her is...
lines.zh: : 想想看，他跟她相处的时间那么少，却注意到了我们俩都没察觉的事，这……

lines.en: : Kind of impressive, right?
lines.zh: : 挺了不起的，对吧？

lines.en: : I suppose an outsider’s perspective really helps sometimes. I can see now why your sister decided to marry him.
lines.zh: : 看来局外人的视角有时确实管用。我现在明白你妹妹为什么决定嫁给他了。

lines.en: scene toukabath8
: Guh.
: Would you mind explaining how that came about?
lines.zh: : 你介意解释一下那是怎么回事吗？

lines.en: : That...is the unfortunate result of a joke I made in poor taste earlier. Which is precisely why I normally abstain from comedy altogether. It is very much a weakness of mine.
lines.zh: : 那……是我早些时候开了个不得体的玩笑，才闹成这样。所以我平常才一概不碰喜剧。这确实是我的软肋。

lines.en: : Did it make you jealous hearing her say that?
lines.zh: : 听她那么说，你吃醋了吗？

lines.en: scene toukabath9
: What? Of course not. I just think she should behave around her elders and it irritates me that she’s able to be so...crass. It's as if she doesn’t have a care in the world.
lines.zh: : 什么？当然没有。我只是觉得她在长辈面前该有分寸，她那么……粗俗，让我恼火。就好像她对什么都不上心。

lines.en: : So you’d accept if she {i}did{/i} become his betrothed?
lines.zh: : 那要是她{i}真{/i}成了他的未婚妻，你能接受吗？

lines.en: scene toukabath10
: Mother, just what exactly are you getting at? Why even joke about such a thing?
lines.zh: : 母亲，您到底想说什么？干嘛拿这种事开玩笑？

lines.en: : Hahah! I suppose I’m just as weak when it comes to comedy as you are.
lines.zh: : 哈哈！看来在喜剧方面，我跟你一样不行。

lines.en: scene toukabath11
: I suppose we should just stick to what we do best and let those with less on their plates be the ones to provide the entertainment.
lines.zh: : 看来我们还是各守本分，把「娱乐」留给那些肩上担子轻点的人吧。

lines.en: : That said, your teacher really {i}is{/i} quite the character, isn’t he?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你老师可{i}真是{/i}个妙人，对吧？

lines.en: : Well...yes. But how much time have you been spending with him exactly? Because there are certain...{i}things{/i} about him that I can’t imagine you’d brush off as...quirkiness.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……是。可您到底跟他相处了多久？因为他有些……{i}地方{/i}，我很难想象您能当成……「小怪癖」一带而过。

lines.en: : Quite a lot, actually. We’re...{i}partners{/i} of sorts. Though, I doubt he’d say the same if you were to ask him.
lines.zh: : 其实挺久的。我们算是……某种{i}「搭档」{/i}。不过你要是问他，他多半不会这么说。

lines.en: scene toukabath12
: I didn’t need to. He came to {i}me{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我不用问。他主动来找{i}我{/i}的。

lines.en: : Oh?
: I know all about your little scheme to turn my apartment complex into a...re-homing site for the Chosokabe sisters. And I know about Sensei’s involvement in it as well.
lines.zh: : 你们想把我那栋公寓楼变成……长宗我部姐妹「安置点」的小算盘，我一清二楚。Sensei 在里头掺和的事我也知道。

lines.en: : What I {i}wish{/i} I knew is why you neglected to provide me the specific details.
lines.zh: : 我{i}想不通{/i}的是，你为什么不肯把具体细节告诉我。

lines.en: : Unless this is just another of your {i}lies{/i}. I wouldn’t put it past you, given what you pulled tonight.
lines.zh: : 除非这又是你的一个{i}谎{/i}。就凭你今晚干的事，我可不敢打包票。

lines.en: : Are you...{i}upset{/i} with me?
lines.zh: : 您……{i}生我的气{/i}了？

lines.en: scene toukabath13
: No...it’s not that. I agree with everything you’ve done and I understand how...absorbed you become in certain things. I just feel as if I was robbed of a chance to impress you myself.
lines.zh: : 没有……不是那样。你做的事我都赞成，我也懂你一扎进某些事里就有多……专注。我只是觉得，我错过了一个亲自让您刮目相看的機会。

lines.en: : Touka, you don’t need to do something like that to impress me. Just...speaking your mind the way you’re doing right now is impressive.
lines.zh: : Touka，你不需要做那种事来让我刮目相看。就……像你现在这样把心里话说出来，就很让我佩服了。

lines.en: : I think that may be the first time you’ve ever spoken to me like that.
lines.zh: : 我想，这大概是你头一回这么跟我说话。

lines.en: scene toukabath14
: Ah! Please excuse my temperament! It was not my intention to talk down on you, I just-
lines.zh: : 啊！请原谅我的失态！我不是有意顶撞您，我只是——

lines.en: : It’s fine. You needn’t apologize. In fact, I wish you’d be honest like that more often.
lines.zh: : 没事。你不用道歉。其实，我倒希望你以后多这么坦诚。

lines.en: scene toukabath15
: It wasn’t my goal to raise you into a woman who just kneels before anyone with more {i}power{/i} than her. In fact, the most powerful of all are the ones who fight for what they believe in.
lines.zh: : 我把你养大，不是想让你变成一个见了比自己有{i}权势{/i}的人就下跪的女人。恰恰相反，最强大的，是那些为信念而战的人。

lines.en: : {i}That{/i} is what I want you to be — not a second Tsubasa Tsukioka. Though, I must say, I am quite flattered by just how much of myself I see in you.
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}才是我希望你成为的样子——而不是第二个 Tsubasa Tsukioka。不过我得承认，在你身上看到这么多「我自己」，我挺受用的。

lines.en: scene toukabath16
: You’re a beautiful young woman, Touka. And I’m sure you’ll be an even more beautiful figurehead one day.
lines.zh: : 你是个美丽的年轻姑娘，Touka。我相信总有一天，你会成为一位更美的家主。

lines.en: : And while we’re at it, I suppose I should also apologize for sticking my hands where they don’t belong. I simply wanted a better life for Chika and her sister.
lines.zh: : 既然说到这儿了，我想我也该为「把手伸到不该伸的地方」道个歉。我只是想让 Chika 和她妹妹过得好一点。

lines.en: scene toukabath17
: I know...which is why I said I agree with you.
lines.zh: : 我知道……所以我才说我赞成您。

lines.en: : Additionally, the reason I don’t speak to you in such an...uncouth way more often is that I simply admire everything you do and seldom hear anything I disagree with.
lines.zh: : 另外，我之所以不常用这种……没大没小的方式跟你说话，纯粹是因为我敬佩你做的一切，很少听到我有异议的。

lines.en: : It just felt a little bit like you didn’t trust me this time. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 只是这次，我有点觉得您不信任我。仅此而已。

lines.en: : That’s not it at all, dear. I tried to involve you as much as I could. There are just certain aspects of Sensei’s involvement that would best be kept under wraps.
lines.zh: : 完全不是那样，亲爱的。我已经尽量让你参与了。只是 Sensei 的介入有些方面，最好还是别声张。

lines.en: : I likely know about those as well.
lines.zh: : 那些方面我多半也知道。

lines.en: scene toukabath18
: You...do?
lines.zh: : 你……知道？

lines.en: : Sensei explained the whole situation to me. How his relationship with Chika is not...of the normal student-teacher variety.
lines.zh: : Sensei 把来龙去脉都跟我解释了。他跟 Chika 的关系……不是正常师生关系那种。

lines.en: scene toukabath19
: He openly told you that?! Are you sure you didn’t just...discern this information on your own?
lines.zh: : 他居然当面跟你说了？！你确定那不是你自己……琢磨出来的？

lines.en: : He omitted {i}some{/i} of the details, but...it was quite obvious what he was trying to say.
lines.zh: : 他省略了{i}些{/i}细节，但……他想说什么已经很明显了。

lines.en: scene toukabath20
: Ugh. Just when I was beginning to believe I understood him. What a confusing man he is.
lines.zh: : 唉。我刚还以为自己开始懂他了。他这人也太难懂了。

lines.en: : The bright side to all of this, though, is that it means he trusts you. And that’s something that can be leveraged.
lines.zh: : 不过，这事好就好在：这意味着他信任你。而信任是可以「利用」的。

lines.en: scene toukabath21
: Leveraged?...
: Not for anything improper, of course. It’s just information you can use to plot out your next action.
lines.zh: : 当然不是拿去干什么坏事。只是你可以拿这条信息，去谋划你的下一步行动。

lines.en: : My next...what? I’m not sure what you mean by that.
lines.zh: : 我的下一……什么？我不太明白您的意思。

lines.en: : Am I to take over the responsibilities of relocating the Chosokabe family in your stead?
lines.zh: : 您是想让我接手「安置长宗我部家」的活儿，替您分担？

lines.en: : Of course not. I’m not trying to create more work for you when your schedule is already busy enough.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。你日程本来就够满了，我可不想再给你添活儿。

lines.en: : I simply mean that knowing he trusts you will make it easier for the two of you to sleep together.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，知道他信任你，你们俩上床会更容易些。

lines.en: : Can you please repeat that? I think there may be water in my ears.
lines.zh: : 您能再说一遍吗？我觉得我耳朵里进水了。

lines.en: : You {i}do{/i} want to sleep with him, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你{i}是{/i}想跟他上床的，对吧？

lines.en: scene toukabath22
: What?! Why?!....What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！为什么？！……什么？！

lines.en: : There’s no need to yell, dear. You’re at the age where it’s completely natural to be thinking about things like that.
lines.zh: : 用不着大喊，亲爱的。到了你这个年纪，想那种事完全正常。

lines.en: : Plus, it was written all over your face earlier. In fact, it’s written on there now as well.
lines.zh: : 再说，刚才全写在你脸上了。其实，现在也还写着呢。

lines.en: : Have you gone mad?! What is happening right now?!
lines.zh: : 您疯了吗？！现在到底怎么回事？！

lines.en: scene toukabath23
: We’re bonding! Oh, it’s been so long since I’ve been able to engage in “girl talk” with anyone. And seeing as I’m your mother, there's no need to shy away from touchy subjects like intercourse.
lines.zh: : 我们在「增进感情」呀！哦，我好久没能跟人进行这种「闺蜜夜谈」了。而且我是你母亲，像性交这种敏感话题，没什么不好意思聊的。

lines.en: : Do you have any questions for me? I’d be happy to help.
lines.zh: : 你有什么想问我的吗？我很乐意帮忙。

lines.en: : Only about a million or so.
lines.zh: : 大概有一百万个吧。

lines.en: : Well, let’s start with one and see how things go from there. Shoot.
lines.zh: : 那先从一个开始，看看再说。问吧。

lines.en: : {i}Shoot.{/i}
scene toukabath24
: Touka, there’s absolutely nothing wrong with feeling the way you feel. Well, at least not from your perspective.
lines.zh: : Touka，你有那种感觉完全没什么不对。至少，从你的角度说是这样。

lines.en: : Your body is going through changes and-
lines.zh: : 你的身体正在发生变化，而且——

lines.en: : I have seen more than enough “instructional videos” to know precisely what “changes” my body is going through, Mother.
lines.zh: : 我看过足够多的「教学视频」，很清楚自己的身体在经历什么「变化」，母亲。

lines.en: : What I do {i}not{/i} see is why you’d insinuate and seemingly {i}endorse{/i} me doing something like that with my teacher when I’m still this...young.
lines.zh: : 我看{i}不明白{/i}的是，您为什么要暗示、甚至似乎{i}「赞同」{/i}我在还这么……小的时候，跟我老师做那种事。

lines.en: scene toukabath25
: Because we’re in a position fortunate enough to do anything we want whenever it is we want to do it.
lines.zh: : 因为我们所处的位置，幸运到可以随心所欲、想做什么就做什么。

lines.en: : And if there is something {i}you{/i} want, even if you are not supposed to {i}have{/i} it, I don’t mind if you try to reach out and grab it.
lines.zh: : 而且，要是有什么{i}你{/i}想要的——哪怕你「不该」{i}得到{/i}它——我也不介意你伸手去抓。

lines.en: : “It” in this case, of course, being your teacher. Will you at least admit that the thought has crossed your mind?
lines.zh: : 当然，这里的「它」，指的就是你老师。你至少肯承认你动过这个念头吧？

lines.en: : Touka, it’s fine. I will understand.
lines.zh: : Touka，没事的。我会理解的。

lines.en: scene toukabath26
: Of...course it’s crossed my mind. As you said, thinking about such things at my age is completely normal. I am aware of that.
lines.zh: : 我……当然动过这个念头。如您所说，我这个年纪想这种事完全正常。这一点我明白。

lines.en: : Then what is it that’s preventing you from moving forward? The consequences? The...risk? What is it?
lines.zh: : 那是什么拦着你不往前走？是后果？是……风险？到底是什么？

lines.en: : The...{i}everything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是……所有这{i}一切{/i}。

lines.en: : I won’t deny that I...often find myself gravitating toward him in many more ways than I ever expected to, but I don’t believe we’re anywhere near the level required to do something like {i}that{/i} yet.
lines.zh: : 我不否认我……常常在远超我预期的方方面面被他吸引，但我不认为我们现在的关系，到了能做{i}那种事{/i}的「程度」。

lines.en: : Level?
lines.zh: : 程度？

lines.en: scene toukabath27
: What I mean is...we’re not in love.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……我们并不相爱。

lines.en: : I’ve seen the way he acts with some of the other girls in class, and you can {i}feel{/i} a connection between those pairs that he and I distinctly lack.
lines.zh: : 我见过他跟班上其他一些女孩相处的样子，他们之间那种{i}「联结」{/i}，是他和我明显缺少的。

lines.en: : Who am I to take what {i}I{/i} want when I haven’t worked nearly as hard for it as they have?
lines.zh: : 她们为之付出的远比{i}我{/i}还多，我又凭什么去索取我想要的？

lines.en: : Touka, a key benefit to being who we are is not {i}having{/i} to work as hard as others.
lines.zh: : Touka，做「我们这种人」的一大好处，就是{i}不用{/i}像别人那样拼命。

lines.en: : Besides, there’s no need for a connection of that level when you can simply just use him to satisfy the...{i}cravings{/i} you may have. Any man in their right mind would jump for joy at a deal like that.
lines.zh: : 再说，要满足你那些……{i}渴求{/i}，根本不需要那种程度的「联结」。你尽管拿他去用就是。任何脑子正常的男人，接到这种「买卖」都会乐开花。

lines.en: scene toukabath28
: Who are you and what have you done with my perfect mother?!
lines.zh: : 你是谁？你把我完美的母亲怎么了？！

lines.en: : Perfection is just a mask we put on to impress those around us. When that mask comes off, we’re all the same, Touka.
lines.zh: : 「完美」只是我们戴来给周围人看的面具。面具一摘，我们都一样，Touka。

lines.en: : I’m not endorsing the idea of you going around and sleeping with all of the remaining men in Kumon-mi. I’m just saying I trust your judgement and wouldn’t blame you for indulging those desires of yours.
lines.zh: : 我不是赞同你到处去跟公文美剩下的男人睡觉。我只是说，我信任你的判断，就算你放纵那些欲望，我也不会怪你。

lines.en: scene toukabath29
: It doesn’t even have to be Sensei if you’re dead set on being “in love” with him first. We have an entire massage staff who would be more than happy to {i}assist{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 你要是非得先跟他「相爱」不可，那也不必非得是 Sensei。我们有整整一支按摩团队，都很乐意为你{i}效劳{/i}。

lines.en: : How do you think {i}I{/i} stayed sane when I was your age?
lines.zh: : 不然你以为{i}我{/i}在你这个年纪是怎么保持理智的？

lines.en: scene toukabath30
: Mother!
lines.zh: : 母亲！

lines.en: : Ahh...how I miss those days. Things are no fun anymore now that I’m unable to let my guard down.
lines.zh: : 啊……真怀念那些日子。如今我再也不能放松警惕，日子一点意思都没有了。

lines.en: scene toukabath31
: But it doesn’t have to be that way for you. You can-
lines.zh: : 但你不必那样。你可以——

lines.en: : Oh, no. Don’t you go admitting something like that and then giving me a motivational speech about why it’s okay to abuse the massage staff.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。您别先自爆了那种事，然后转头又来给我灌「为什么滥用按摩团队没关系」的鸡汤。

lines.en: scene toukabath32
: {i}Abuse?{/i} I’d never make them do anything they didn’t already want to. And if it weren’t for my mother, I never would have known about those services in the first place.
lines.zh: : {i}滥用{/i}？我从没逼他们做过任何他们本不愿做的事。而且要不是因为我母亲，我压根不会知道还有那种「服务」。

lines.en: : This goes back generations and generations, Touka. It’s not a new thing.
lines.zh: : 这都传了一代又一代了，Touka。不是什么新鲜事。

lines.en: : This tradition...ends with me.
lines.zh: : 这项「传统」……到我这儿为止。

lines.en: scene toukabath33
: {i}Why?{/i} It’s completely natural and {i}really{/i} helps take the edge off. If you think this bath is relaxing, just imagine how-
lines.zh: : {i}为什么{/i}？这完全是人之常情，而且{i}特别{/i}解压。你要是觉得这个澡泡得舒服，想象一下——

lines.en: : Mother.
lines.zh: : 母亲。
: ……怎么了？

lines.en: : I do not want to talk to you right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在不想跟您说话。

lines.en: scene toukabath34
: Fine. Two can play at that game. But don’t come crying to me when your urges become too much for you to bear.
lines.zh: : 行。那我也奉陪。不过等你的「冲动」憋不住的时候，可别哭着来找我。

lines.en: : As my mother, you would be the last person I’d ever come to for that in the first place.
lines.zh: : 作为我母亲，那种事我第一个就不会来找您。

lines.en: : Hmph!
: Hmph!
scene toukabath35
: This was fun. We should spend time together like this more often.
lines.zh: : 今晚挺开心的。我们该多这样聚聚。

lines.en: : I agree. Looking past the many things I learned about you tonight, it was very nice getting to speak to you in a way much...different than normal.
lines.zh: : 我同意。撇开我今晚得知的关于你的那些事不谈，能用这种……跟平常大不一样的方式跟你说话，真的很好。

lines.en: : And I mean {i}much{/i} different. I wasn’t even aware this side of you existed.
lines.zh: : 而且是{i}「大不一样」{/i}。我根本不知道你还有这一面。

lines.en: scene toukabath36
: What do you say to having our next get-together in the massage lounge?
lines.zh: : 你说，我们下次聚会定在按摩休息室怎么样？

lines.en: : I say that I am suddenly tired and have decided to retire for the night.
lines.zh: : 我说我突然累了，今晚就到这儿。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Mother. If that is {i}really{/i} who you are.
lines.zh: : 晚安，母亲。如果您{i}真的{/i}是我「母亲」的话。

lines.en: scene black
: It’s who I’ve always been, dear. I just think you’re mature enough to hear about it now.
lines.zh: : 我一直都是我，亲爱的。我只是觉得你现在成熟到能听这些了。

lines.en: : I’m barely a freshman!
lines.zh: : 我才刚上高一！

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
I peel off my shirt, now drenched with cum from battling loneliness, and toss it across the room into a pile of others that have met the same fate.
lines.zh: 我脱下上衣——它被「对抗孤独」的战果浸透了——把它甩到房间另一头，丢进那堆同样命运的衣服里。

lines.en: You’d never guess who I thought of tonight.
lines.zh: 你绝对猜不到我今晚想的是谁。

lines.en: scene black
I hope she thought the same of me.
lines.zh: 我希望她也想到了我。

lines.en: And I hope her clothes are lying in a pile right now.
lines.zh: 也希望她的衣服此刻正堆成一堆。

lines.en: {i}She did.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她想到了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And they were.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而且也堆成一堆了。{/i}

$ touka_love += 1
{i}Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Touka 的好感度上升到了 [touka_love]！{/i}
